wrongHypotheses.qualification: The best absolute clock is a descriptive failure diagnostic, not a heldout refit accepted as a law. Frozen per-offset training outcomes remain in the lock.

qualified: All four supplied palette roles and a repeatable two-pixel flight-displacement phase pattern across fresh changed waits and pauses. Whole images freeze during pause. Actual raw-response-native counts are not an exact two-frame clock.
unresolved: Interpreting one horizontal pixel as one active simulation update requires independent Star motion/timestep calibration. A pure palette law is not a measured physics law.
An engine-global palette epoch, post-bounce/reversal phase and other worlds/areas are not qualified. Do not implement universalglobalclock or universalorange.
Partially missing sprite rows are retained outside complete-pose counts. Palette/timing is not claimed exact when the full122pixel template does not match.
